caption: The drawing features a single ceramic jug positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background. The jug is beige with subtle brown shading, suggesting age or use, and the interior is a darker brown, possibly indicating glaze. It has a rounded body with a small base and a handle attached to its upper right side, viewed from an angle. The jug bears blue decorative motifs on its front, consisting of stylized leaf and swirl patterns. Near the jug’s top, there is blue text that partially reads “E. CLARK & CO. ROCHESTER, N.Y.” In the lower left corner of the drawing, the artist's name, “JESSIE M. YOUNGS,” is written in small, black letters. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
